newsitem.title: UK: NWE NAPHTHA WET VERY SLOW, PAPER SLIGHTLY BUSIER.
newsitem.headline: NWE NAPHTHA WET VERY SLOW, PAPER SLIGHTLY BUSIER.

text.p: NWE naphtha closely tracked crude on Tuesday, but trade was quiet.
Dealers said the physical market was very slow with buyers looking balanced and sellers seemingly under no great pressure to reduce prices in order to conclude a deal.

Delivered naphtha cargoes were pegged around $191.50 with swaps marginally stronger in response to crude's modest gains. Traders said the balance of August was talked around $193.00 with September around $187.50.
August traded at $192.50 and September at $187.00.

End-user demand remained muted and there appeared to be more than sufficient material. Dealers said an ex-Tallin Dow spec cargo was available. An 80 paraffin cargo was also looking for buyers along with a 63 paraffin ex Ventspils cargo.
